RT-qPCR time-course plots show mean ± SEM (n = 3–4, per caption) but the underlying individual replicate values are not overlaid on the curves.
Live fluorescence images of EBs; not a plot of averaged data.
Flow cytometry dot plots display individual single-cell measurements directly, so no separate averaging obscures individual data.

Tukey boxplots summarizing RNA-seq quantifications (n = 3 biological experiments) show only the box-and-whisker summary statistics; no individual replicate data points are overlaid, which is especially important given the small sample size (n=3).
Heatmap columns display expression values for individual samples/replicates directly rather than a collapsed average, so individual data are visible.
